title: Starter Hub — hero, step diagrams, and annotated screenshots for quickstart landing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Refresh the Quickstart landing visuals by designing a cohesive Starter Hub hero, a set of step-by-step diagrams, and annotated product screenshots for docs and release pages. This ticket covers art direction, responsive hero layouts, simplified technical diagrams (routing, model selection, and caching), annotated UI screenshots for the quickstart doc, and export-ready assets for marketing and the Console release notes. Aim is to reduce first-time setup time by clarifying the onboarding path and surface critical callouts (API keys, region selection, model pinning) in screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Final hero art + 3 responsive breakpoints (desktop/tablet/mobile) exported as PNG and SVG
Set of 4 step diagrams (Get API Key → Create Project → Choose Model → Test) in both color and monochrome variants
Annotated Console screenshots with callouts and copy approved by PM and Docs
Figma file handed off with component tokens, export presets, and naming conventions for engineering
Design passes accessibility review checklist (color contrast, alt text drafts, readable type sizes)
